raw.title: Lead Engineer (UK)
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.


What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.


Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The role

  • Extend screening to new payment types and build automated testing so improvements stick.

  • False positives and manual workload fall measurably, without weakening detection.

  • Hire, mentor, and manage a team of Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching, and career development.

  • Establish and operationalize best practices for pre-sales solutioning, proof-of-concepts, and technical validation.

  • Partner with Sales leadership to co-develop go-to-market strategies and align technical execution with business goals.

  • Engage directly with a select portfolio of strategic enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through discovery, solution design, and ROI validation.

  • Ensure your team delivers compelling demonstrations, prototypes, and solution architectures tailored to customer needs.

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration with Product and Engineering to bring customer insights into roadmap priorities.

  • Serve as an executive-level technical representative in customer meetings, technical workshops, and industry events.

  • Define scalable processes and assets to support team efficiency, repeatability, and long-term growth.

  • Stay current on enterprise AI adoption patterns, integration strategies, and the evolving competitive landscape.

  • 7+ years of experience in pre-sales technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or equivalent.

  • 3+ years of experience managing or leading pre-sales/solutions engineering teams.

  • Proven success working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex buying cycles.

  • Strong technical proficiency with enterprise AI deployments, API integrations, and production system architectures.

  • Ability to thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments with significant ambiguity.

  • Strong executive presence and consultative skills, capable of establishing trust and credibility with senior leaders.

  • Experience in AI/Generative AI pre-sales engineering or enterprise deployments.

  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture design, developer tooling, SDKs, and integration patterns.

  • Background in software engineering or systems engineering, enabling you to dive deeply into technical discussions.

  • Experience integrating telephony infrastructure or other complex enterprise systems.

  • Knowledge of LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, and AI-powered solution design.

  • Thought leadership experience through conferences, webinars, or published technical content.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Technology and Cyber team are looking for an experienced Database and Analytics Engineer to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>Baringa has grown so fast, and it continues to grow rapidly. Those new joiners keep on coming! We are a global function supporting the firm as it enters new markets. We are re-architecting and evolving our cloud-based business systems and infrastructure. We are on a mission to develop great technology products, deliver great services, and protect the trust our people and clients place in us. We have installed a new operating system for ourselves, and rebooted what was a corporate IT department into a corporate technology company, transforming the way we work.</p> <p>Now we are building for the next era of work. AI is becoming part of the fabric of how Baringa operates, and we are developing the products and platforms that will help colleagues find knowledge, act on insight, navigate complexity, and get work done with greater speed, quality, and confidence. Some of this will be visible through intelligent experiences and agentic systems. Some of it will sit beneath the surface: data products, workflow platforms, integrations, automations, cyber security, governance, and the architecture that makes all of it safe, scalable, resilient, and useful.</p> <p>So much to build on, so much to progress. So much to deliver. So much to play for!</p> <p>Do you know what though? We are going to do it. All of it and more. We have the support to drive change. We have the belief. We are going to do great things. Come and join us!</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>We are on a business systems modernization journey. You will help evolve and engineer the data, analytics and application solutions that underpin critical processes and products across the firm, balancing operational excellence with future scalability.</li> <li>As a Principal Database &amp; Analytics Engineer within the Technology Product team, you will take a hands-on role in designing, building and supporting robust data and application solutions that deliver measurable business value.</li> <li>Lead the engineering, optimisation and continuous improvement of our database estate, ensuring performance, resilience, security and maintainability remain at the heart of everything we build.</li> <li>Partner with Product Owners, Engineers and business stakeholders to modernise legacy solutions, reducing technical debt and enabling more scalable, supportable and cloud-ready platforms.</li> <li>Design and deliver meaningful reporting, analytics and data products that improve decision making and unlock insight across the firm.</li> <li>Build and support business-critical applications, integrating data, automation and user experiences into solutions that solve real business problems.</li> <li>Act as a technical authority for database and analytics engineering, establishing best practice, mentoring colleagues and raising engineering standards across our Technology &amp; Cyber function.</li> <li>Whilst this is an engineering role, we are a multi-skilled team. Providing proof of concepts, solving complex technical challenges and rolling up your sleeves to deliver great outcomes will be a core part of the role.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in SQL Server and database engineering, including performance optimisation, schema design, data modelling and operational support.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of relational database design principles, normalisation and data modelling.</li> <li>Ability to write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and functions.</li> <li>Strong mathematical aptitude with the ability to analyse complex datasets and processes.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of DAX and Power Query (M language).</li> <li>Experience working with Azure SQL Managed Instance (MI) - including configuration, connectivity, authentication, security and troubleshooting integration with cloud-based systems</li> <li>Performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies.</li> <li>Experience with ETL processes and data integration.</li> <li>Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and information security principles.</li> <li>Familiarity with source control and software development lifecycle practices.</li> <li>Strong experience delivering business applications, integrations and data-driven solutions that solve complex organisational challenges.</li> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into well-engineered technical solutions.</li> <li>Experience designing and supporting reporting and analytics capabilities, ideally including Power BI and modern Microsoft data technologies including Fabric.</li> <li>Ability to work across technical and non-technical audiences, adapting communication style to suit the stakeholder and situation.</li> <li>Comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with Product Owners, Engineers and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Self-motivated, hands-on and able to balance strategic thinking with delivery-focused execution.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">&nbsp;</p> <h1 data-section-id="1b5pyf7" data-start="1080" data-end="1096">What you'll do</h1> <h3 data-section-id="1rd6iho" data-start="1098" data-end="1136">Advise on AI trust and governance.</h3> <p data-start="1137" data-end="1641">Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1vy74ta" data-start="1643" data-end="1681">Scope and shape AI build projects.</h3> <p data-start="1682" data-end="2121">Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1elmp9s" data-start="2123" data-end="2145">Build and deliver.</h3> <p data-start="2146" data-end="2546">Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.</p> <h3 data-section-id="8xgjwk" data-start="2548" data-end="2590">Own the relationship through delivery.</h3> <p data-start="2591" data-end="2805">Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.</p> <h1 data-section-id="kq6nv6" data-start="2807" data-end="2831">What we're looking for</h1> <h2 data-section-id="1wfooam" data-start="2833" data-end="2846">Must-haves</h2> <ul data-start="2848" data-end="4211"> <li data-section-id="1savupk" data-start="2848" data-end="3035">5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).</li> <li data-section-id="qxlgzp" data-start="3036" data-end="3234">Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.</li> <li data-section-id="5cohv6" data-start="3235" data-end="3474"><strong data-start="3237" data-end="3268">Machine Learning Expertise:</strong> Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.</li> <li data-section-id="4qgzw0" data-start="3475" data-end="3667">Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.</li> <li data-section-id="u9bkd2" data-start="3668" data-end="3894">Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.</li> <li data-section-id="i43vcd" data-start="3895" data-end="4098">Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.</li> <li data-section-id="16b5uac" data-start="4099" data-end="4211">Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.</li> </ul> <h2 data-section-id="gbyf8a" data-start="4213" data-end="4229">Strong pluses</h2> <ul data-start="4231" data-end="5098"> <li data-section-id="otf7d0" data-start="4231" data-end="4368">Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.</li> <li data-section-id="1457rsl" data-start="4369" data-end="4515">Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).</li> <li data-section-id="1l5daxl" data-start="4516" data-end="4648">Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).</li> <li data-section-id="3crjn8" data-start="4649" data-end="4791">Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.</li> <li data-section-id="1h63k2g" data-start="4792" data-end="4936">Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.</li> <li data-section-id="1d0p8e3" data-start="4937" data-end="5036">Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.</li> <li data-section-id="49tosn" data-start="5037" data-end="5098">Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1 data-section-id="1bghwns" data-start="5100" data-end="5127">How we'll measure success</h1> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421">Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next. This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions. Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth. This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey. We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact. What will you be doing? Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM. Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making. Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics. Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources. Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs. Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality. Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders. What do you need? Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment. Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders. Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action. A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions. Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently. Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage. As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. raw.description:

***As this position in based in England, the job description is available in English only.***
 
_________________________________________________
Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident)
Sales, Marketing and Communications
Full-Time Position


Reports to: SVP Communications

Scope: All international shows outside the Americas (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific & Oceania) + Public Affairs
 
Teams: Touring show PR teams (embedded on tour) + Resident show PR teams, and their respective agency rosters
 
 
Role Purpose
 
The Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) is responsible for driving demand, building anticipation, and ensuring cultural relevance for Cirque du Soleil’s shows across all markets outside the Americas.
 
This role elevates show communications into a strategic growth engine, integrating PR, earned media, and public affairs to create urgency, unlock market opportunities, and support commercial performance across every international production.
 
Based in London, this role acts as the central show communications and public affairs lead for international markets, ensuring alignment between show storytelling, market-level marketing plans, and cross-functional execution across multiple time zones, languages, and regulatory environments.
 
 
Core Mission
  • Drive anticipation, urgency, and sustained demand for international touring and resident shows
  • Make communications a core lever of the show marketing mix, fully integrated with paid, CRM, and ticketing
  • Lead, develop, and set standards for the touring and resident show PR teams and the agencies that support them
  • Own the strategy and governance of show-specific social media channels as an earned and owned demand driver
  • Leverage public affairs as a growth enabler to unlock market access, market entry, and partnerships
  • Ensure communications is a core driver of ticket revenue and brand equity outside the Americas
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment to deliver cohesive show launches across diverse international markets
Key Responsibilities
 
1. Show Communications Strategy – International Touring, Resident Shows & Public Affairs
  • Lead and oversee an international show communications strategy spanning touring productions, resident shows, and public affairs
  • Embed communications within the end-to-end demand engine (onsale → launch → sustain), in lockstep with market marketing plans
  • Integrate public affairs into market entry and growth strategies for new territories
  • Lead communications strategy in support of sponsorships and business development, including building relationships with key stakeholders, and developing joint communication plans with partners
2. Show Communications Leadership (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, APAC & Oceania)
  • Own communications strategy and performance across all international touring and resident productions
  • Ensure each show delivers:
    • Clear, differentiated narrative
    • Strong local and cultural relevance, adapted per market and language
    • Full lifecycle comms (pre-onsale → launch → sustain)
  • Implement standards, playbooks, and governance that scale across markets and local agency partners
  • Act as spokesperson for international shows and manage show-level issues in market, escalating to corporate communications at HQ where required
3. Show-Specific Social Media Ownership
  • Ensure each show PR team owns the strategy, management, and community engagement for its show-specific social media channels
  • Set the content, tone, and publishing standards that keep show channels distinctive while consistent with the masterbrand
  • Align show channel activity to the onsale, launch, and sustain calendar in each market
  • Drive creator, influencer, and talent-led content through show channels to build cultural relevance and organic reach
  • Set and track channel performance measures (growth, engagement, referral to ticketing) alongside earned media KPIs
  • Ensure coordination with central brand and social teams on shared assets, escalation paths, and community management protocols
4. Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Leverage public affairs as a strategic growth enabler by building relationships with:
    • Government and public sector stakeholders across international markets
    • Tourism boards, city partners, venues, and cultural institutions
  • Unlock opportunities to:
    • Support market entry for touring and resident shows
    • Facilitate partnerships and local integration
    • Strengthen Cirque du Soleil’s institutional influence outside the Americas
  • Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to align on regulatory, reputational, and market access considerations, including visas, work permits, and cross-border touring requirements
5. Cross-Functional Orchestration
  • Own coordination across non-marketing functions to ensure aligned execution and messaging around shows, including:
    • Legal
    • HR (incl. talent mobility, immigration)
    • Sustainability
    • Operations
    • Sponsorship & partnerships
  • Act as the central orchestrator ensuring communications supports and amplifies show and market decisions
  • Ensure consistency between internal decisions, external messaging, and market execution, and act as the two-way bridge between international markets and HQ
6. Cultural Relevance & Media Impact
  • Position Cirque du Soleil’s shows as culturally relevant and premium in international markets
  • Build relationships with Tier 1 media, creators, and influencers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • Activate cultural moments and partnerships tied to international show launches and runs
7. Team Leadership, Agency Governance & Performance
  • Lead and develop the PR teams embedded with the touring shows and the PR teams responsible for the resident shows, across multiple markets, time zones, and languages
  • Build a consistent operating model, capability plan, and career path across both team groups, including onboarding for new tours and openings
  • Approve and sign off on all agency appointments, scopes, and budgets proposed by the touring and resident show PR teams
  • Define and manage the international agency ecosystem, setting selection criteria, performance standards, and review cadence
  • Set KPIs tied to business impact (demand, awareness, launch momentum, ticket sales, social channel performance)
  • Partner with marketing and analytics to link comms and social to revenue outcomes
Profile & Experience
 
Required
  • 10+ years in communications/PR with multi-market, international leadership experience
  • Proven ability to operate communications as a growth and demand lever tied to sales outcomes
  • Strong experience in consumer, brand, or entertainment PR, ideally with campaign or launch ownership
  • Experience working with government or public sector stakeholders in international markets
  • Deep media relationships across the UK and Europe, with demonstrated reach into additional international markets
  • Experience directly leading distributed, multi-time-zone in-house teams, including teams embedded with touring operations
  • Proven track record appointing, contracting, and managing PR agencies across multiple markets
  • Strong command of organic social media strategy and community management for consumer or entertainment brands
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with a North America–based headquarters
  • Fluent in English (mandatory); willingness to travel frequently across international markets
Preferred
  • Additional language(s) relevant to key international markets (e.g. French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin)
  • Experience in entertainment, touring productions, live events, or premium brands
  • Strong understanding of how communications integrates with marketing, CRM, and revenue generation

The team will build relationships and programmes across the institutions that create, fund and accelerate startups, then convert that ecosystem position into qualified opportunities and practical advantage for CoreWeave’s country field teams.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Senior Director, Startup Business Development – EMEA will report to the Vice President and Managing Director, EMEA and lead the development of CoreWeave’s startup and venture capital business across the region.</p> <p>This is a business development overlay role. Country sales teams will retain account ownership, opportunity management and revenue responsibility across the Startup, Digital Native and Enterprise segments. You will build the relationships, propositions, programmes, market intelligence and operating mechanisms that help those teams identify the right companies earlier, engage them before platform decisions are established and win them onto CoreWeave.</p> <p>You will build and lead a team spanning priority geographies and regional programmes. Initial focus will include the United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Nordics, Benelux and Israel.</p> <h2><strong>In This Role, You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and execute CoreWeave’s EMEA startup business development strategy, operating plan and investment priorities.</li> <li>Build a systematic view of the regional startup opportunity, identifying the markets, investor portfolios, technology categories and companies most likely to become significant consumers of AI infrastructure.</li> <li>Establish clear criteria for prioritising startups based on technical ambition, compute intensity, funding trajectory, workload timing, leadership quality and strategic value.</li> <li>Build senior relationships with venture capital firms, seed and growth investors, accelerators, universities, research laboratories and founder communities.</li> <li>Develop strategic engagement plans for priority ecosystem organisations and create repeatable mechanisms for portfolio introductions, founder support, technical engagement and market intelligence.</li> <li>Position CoreWeave as the preferred AI infrastructure and developer platform for companies with meaningful training, fine-tuning, inference and applied-intelligence requirements.</li> <li>Engage founders, CTOs, researchers and investors before infrastructure architectures and platform relationships are firmly established.</li> <li>Create qualified opportunities and introductions for country Startup and Digital Native field teams, connecting high-potential companies rapidly to the right sellers, technical resources and executive sponsors.</li> <li>Partner with country sales leaders to define target companies, ecosystem priorities and engagement strategies while maintaining clear account ownership.</li> <li>Coordinate strategically important opportunities across Sales, Field Engineering, Product, Engineering, Capacity, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Customer Success.</li> <li>Establish clear programme eligibility, investment and graduation criteria, ensuring activity is focused on durable platform adoption and commercial potential.</li> <li>Act as the regional voice of the startup ecosystem inside CoreWeave, translating market insight into recommendations for Product, Engineering, Capacity, Marketing and commercial leadership.</li> <li>Build, lead and develop a high-performing EMEA Startup Business Development team with complementary programme and geographic coverage.</li> <li>Establish a rigorous operating cadence and scorecard covering ecosystem coverage, target-company engagement, field acceptance, sourced and influenced pipeline, technical activation, consumption and downstream commercial impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Objectives</strong></h2> <p>During the first 12 months, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Define the EMEA startup business development strategy, operating plan and investment priorities.</li> <li>Develop and launch CoreWeave’s proposition for AI startups at different stages of formation and growth.</li> <li>Design and launch the initial portfolio of regional startup and venture ecosystem programmes.</li> <li>Define the organisation, hire the initial team and establish coverage across priority programmes and geographies.</li> <li>Identify, segment and onboard the venture capital firms, accelerators, universities and research organisations most relevant to CoreWeave.</li> <li>Establish senior relationships and strategic engagement plans with priority ecosystem partners.</li> <li>Create mechanisms for portfolio introductions, technical engagement, founder support and joint planning.</li> <li>Build and maintain a prioritised target list of high-potential AI startups and research spinouts.</li> <li>Map priority investor portfolios against CoreWeave’s ideal startup profile and connect qualified companies to the appropriate country sales teams.</li> <li>Establish clear ways of working with country field sales teams, including qualification, routing, account assignment, handoff, executive sponsorship and attribution.</li> <li>Establish effective operating mechanisms with Product, Engineering, Field Engineering, Marketing, Capacity, Finance, Legal and other supporting groups.</li> <li>Implement the business review cadence, measurement framework and attribution model required to assess ecosystem and field impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, startup go-to-market or venture ecosystem leadership within cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology, AI or another complex technology environment.</li> <li>Significant leadership experience building and operating startup, venture capital or ecosystem programmes across multiple EMEA markets.</li> <li>A proven record of converting ecosystem relationships into qualified opportunities, technical adoption, pipeline, consumption and commercial growth.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing senior relationships with venture capital firms, accelerators, universities, research organisations, founders, CTOs and technology executives.</li> <li>Experience working with country sales organisations to create demand and accelerate customer acquisition without displacing account ownership.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the startup lifecycle, from formation and seed funding through venture growth and scaled commercial operation.</li> <li>Experience identifying promising companies early and assessing their technical ambition, infrastructure needs, funding trajectory and long-term potential.</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, developer tooling and the requirements of AI-native companies.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build structured programmes, operating mechanisms and performance measures that scale beyond personal relationships.</li> <li>Experience aligning Sales, portfolio analysis, opportunity attribution and executive business reviews.</li> <li>Experience building, hiring, coaching and developing high-performing business development or ecosystem teams.</li> startup organisation of a major hyperscale cloud provider, AI platform company or global infrastructure technology business.</li> <li>Direct experience building or scaling a regional startup business measured through customer acquisition, workload adoption, consumption and revenue.</li> <li>Experience designing the operating model between a regional startup business development organisation and training, fine-tuning, inference, applied AI or AI platform development.</li> <li>Experience creating startup programmes or technical adoption mechanisms that helped companies progress from experimentation to scaled production workloads.</li> <li>Experience influencing product, capacity and go-to-market decisions using insight from founders, investors and startups.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p>We will also consider an exceptional senior venture ecosystem builder who has strong credibility with EMEA investors and founders, can identify high-potential technical companies early and has translated ecosystem access into measurable commercial outcomes for a technology platform.</p> <p>Experience focused primarily on events, sponsorships, brand awareness or community activity will not, by itself, be sufficient.</p> <h2><strong>Wondering If You’re a Good Fit?</strong></h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people and value candidates
